- Weakness: a specific CWE identifier (e.g., CWE-89) or fundamental flaw class.

Both sub-technique IDs (e.g., T1090.002) and parent technique IDs (e.g., T1090) are valid when explicitly stated. Only exact MITRE ATT&CK T-code substrings qualify.
